articles.summary: – Well-Balanced thermal, switching and EMI performance for compact power designs – 500 V and 600 V options for greater flexibility in PCB layout and thermal design SEOUL, South Korea — Magnachip Semiconductor Corporation (“Magnachip”) today expanded its power semiconductor portfolio with 15 new sixth-generation (Gen6) E6 super-junction (SJ) MOSFETs for consumer and computing […] The post Magnachip Launches 15 New Gen6 E6 Super-Junction MOSFETs for TVs, Notebook Adapters and PC Power Supplies appeared first on Magnachip Semiconductor .
articles.title: Magnachip Launches 15 New Gen6 E6 Super-Junction MOSFETs for TVs, Notebook Adapters and PC Power Supplies
